citation.title: Radney Analysis: A Complete Cephalometric Guide

curation.notes: accessed 2026-10-07 (both extractors read the live page that day). Page dated June 12, 2026. The page names Creekmore (1997) and Casko & Shepherd (1984) as sources on dental compensation; no sample described. Merge 2026-10-08: a and b agree on every value, unit and definitionMatch; only the source wording differed (b's row-specific wording kept). Re-read with WebFetch on 2026-10-08 (15:22): every value matched, including both incisor angles at 22° ± 2°.

caveats: Website values, not from a paper (status website; never coloured).
The page prints every norm as 'x ± y' without saying whether y is an SD or a range; stored as sd with a note.
No sample, population, sex or age stated on the page.
U1–NA (°) and L1–NA (°) are both printed 22 ± 2 (confirmed on the 8 Oct re-read). This may be a duplication on onfile; kept as printed.
